'''Bilbousa''' was a large port town and [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. It was considered one of the most prominent of its type on the world. [[Bilbousa Bazaar/Legends|Bilbousa Bazaar]] and [[Bilbousa Spaceport/Legends|Bilbousa Spaceport]] could be found here as possible points of interest. [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Unidentified Nikto guard (Nal Hutta)/Legends|gua]][[Unidentified Nikto pilot/Legends|rds]] part of [[Gardulla the Elder's criminal empire]] appeared to be the corrupt enforcers of law in the town.
